preconditions.description: The dimensions of the garden must be within the range of 1 to 500 meters.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= h <= 999 for row in garden for h in row)
preconditions.description: All height values in the garden must be between 0 and 999 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(garden) == y and all(len(row) == x for row in garden)
preconditions.description: The garden must have exactly y rows, each containing x height values.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of square metres of land that can grow rice, represented as a string.

postconditions.expression: count == sum(1 for i in range(y) for j in range(x) if can_pool(i, j))
postconditions.description: The count of rice-growing cells must equal the number of cells that can pool water based on the defined water flow logic.
